svg.title: Unfolded Block Anatomy of P_s = P* rho(s) P Across the Three Regimes of G_bar = G_{p_0} x G_{p_1}
svg.desc: Publication-grade editorial mathematical diagram of the relative-trace unfolding in src/New/Spanning/Unfolding/Moments.lean (Stage 04). Top left (cobalt, solid): schematic of the class-indexed block matrix P_s = P* rho(s) P acting on H_src = Classes x BesselCoord (dimension D_X) under HasAmplitudeBlocks, highlighting block (c, c') with formula block(c, c') = conj(A^full(c, s, c') / nu), where A^full(c, s, c') sums archimedean orbital overlap integrals A_gamma = integral beta_c(y) beta_{c'}(gamma^-1 y) W(y) tensor W(gamma^-1 y)* dy over gamma in S.termsOver c s c', giving ||P_s||_HS^2 = nu^-2 sum_{c,c'} ||A^full(c, s, c')||^2 (hilbertSchmidtNorm_sq_eq_secondMoment). Top right (rust, solid-to-dashed bridge): Archimedean Full to Cut Bridge passing from the smooth discrete-series Bessel vector W (.full, built via LargeFunction.lean and Appendix/DiscreteSeries/Periods.lean Laplace lower bound with derivative control from SchurBound.lean) via besselCut to the compactly supported cut Bessel function W^flat (.cut, supported on besselLength <= b^{6n+2} with L^2 tail bound in CutTailBound.lean). Middle band: partition of G_bar = G_{p_0} x G_{p_1} into three regimes. Regime 1 (emerald, solid, filled circle): Bessel subgroup R_bar_0 carrying the unitary representation besselTranslate r_psi(s) with rho(t) P = P r_psi(t); off-R_bar_0 error on a one-prime slice is <= b^-12 D_id (sum_hilbertSchmidtNorm_sub_besselTranslate_sq_le), which divides by #R_bar_0 to yield ||P* P - 1||_HS^2 <= b^-12 D_X (hilbertSchmidtNorm_sub_one_sq_le). Regime 2 (cobalt, solid, filled diamond): Open Big Cell (IsOpenElement s, nonzero proper leading minors), fed to the EnergyEstimate.lean Kloosterman sieve to bound each link by (1 + b^-4) b^{-6k|S_g|} D_main and supply the leading (1 + b^-4) D_main term (linkSecondMoment_isOpenElement_le). Regime 3 (amber, dashed, filled triangle): Remaining Terms in RemainingTerms/Sum.lean splitting cross-link and g = 0 pairs (<= b^{-kf} D_id, secondMoment_remainingTerms_le) and same-link meeting reductions with meetNorm s >= z (<= (b^{2f}/z)^k D_main). Bottom band (cobalt-accented synthesis): why two level primes M = p_0 p_1 close good-forms near-isometry. Step 1 splits 1 - g_0 tensor g_1 = (1 - g_0) tensor 1 + g_0 tensor (1 - g_1) with Re((1 - g_i)(1)) <= b^-8 / 2. Step 2 holds s(i+1) = 1 at the complementary prime, forcing k in besselU (mem_besselU_of_reduction_eq_one) and simplifying tr(r_psi(s)) = D_X psi_U(s). Step 3 applies Cauchy-Schwarz against sum |psi_U^natural|^2 <= 2 (sum_norm_reducedCharMean_sq_le) across both primes to get ||(1 - e_0) P||_HS^2 <= 4 b^-4 D_X. Closing outcome cards state isNearIsometry_piTensorElem_comp with error 5 b^-4 alongside sum_hilbertSchmidtNorm_sq_le bounding sum_{s in G_bar} ||P* rho(s) P||_HS^2 <= (1 + 9 b^-4) D_main.

g.text: Unfolded Block Anatomy of Ps = P* ρ(s) P in Moments.lean
Afull(c, s, c′) = ∑γ Aγ (γ ∈ S.termsOver c s c′)
Rescaled Poincaré inner products → unfolded 2nd moment
Three Regimes of Ḡ = Gp₀ × Gp₁ (two level primes)
Intertwines R̄0: ρ(t) P = P rψ(t) (rψ(1)=1)
Off-R̄0 error on one-prime slice (si+1 ∈ R̄0,i+1):
Equal norm on all t ∈ R̄0 (Did = #R̄0·DX)
Nonzero proper leading minors mod p0, p1
WHY TWO LEVEL PRIMES (M = p0 p1) CLOSE GOOD-FORMS NEAR-ISOMETRY
e0 = g0 ⊗ g1 (central idempotents on G0 × G1)
Bound xi = 1 − gi at prime pi while
holding s(i+1) = 1 at other prime pi+1
Conjugation avg ⇒ class mean ψU♮ (on Ḡ)
Per prime: (√2·√(b−8/2) + b−6) DX ≤ 2 b−4 DX
Combines ‖P*P − 1‖2HS ≤ b−12 DX + ‖(1 − e0)P‖2HS ≤ 4 b−4 DX
